.]] Hallowfall is a subterranean zone in Khaz Algar, located below and to the west of the Ringing Deeps and north and above Azj-Kahet. Hallowfall is a landscape of verdant plateaus and river canyons bordered to the west by the endless Undersea, all within an enormous cavern. Beledar, an immense crystal lodged into the cavern ceiling, provides light, warmth, and growth for vegetation, creating a bright and lush environment reminiscent of the surface world. It is inhabited by the Hallowfall Arathi, an expedition of the Arathi Empire. This quest must be turned in while it's still Saturday server time, though it does not have to be turned in while the buff is still active. The Halloween MP3 is a Blizzard Holiday Skit that was released on October 29, 2004 (a month prior to the release of World of Warcraft) as part of that year's "Blizzard's Elite Halloween Spectacular™". The skit is 8 minutes long and features the first appearance of the Invincible Legion of Unconquerable Vanquishing Gnomes, who go on a forest adventure in search of treasure but are instead repeatedly given free items by people who mistake them for trick-or-treating children. The skit was released as a downloadable MP3 file on Blizzard's website and several third-party gaming websites (Absolute Gamer's Files Archive, Games-Fusion, and GameArena). The haranir ( ) are a reclusive humanoid race that resides in Harandar, a primordial jungle that lies where the roots of the World Trees converge. The haranir have been described as subterranean guardians of sacred and hidden lands. Ancient and ferocious hunters, they were first encountered during the war against Xal'atath in parts of Azj-Kahet where they live in secrecy and protect the great roots growing into the area. They were described as "not really elves, not really trolls"—with tapered, bat-like ears, small tusks, clawed feet with four digits in the front, and one protruding from the heel, and grayish-purple skin partially covered in dark fur and quills. Harandar Peridot is a raw gem crafting reagent used in Midnight Jewelcrafting. Harandar Peridots may be found when Midnight Prospecting Refulgent Copper Ore, Brilliant Silver Ore, Umbral Tin Ore, or Dazzling Thorium. They can also be looted from a School of Gems, which is created with Midnight Alchemy. 5 Harandar Peridot need to be interacted with Camberon's Cauldron to learn the recipe for School of Gems.
Haranir Phial of Perception is a phial made with Midnight Alchemy (10); taught by Recipe: Haranir Phial of Perception. It temporarily increases the imbiber's perception and deftness.
Harandar Stone Sample can be found by jewelcrafters in treasure chests located throughout Midnight zones. Only 1 can be looted per week. It provides 2 Midnight Jewelcrafting Knowledge.
Haranir Preserving Agents is housing decor created with Midnight Alchemy (10). The recipe is learned from Recipe: Haranir Preserving Agents.
